name: Freestore Foodbank — Bea Taylor Market
limitations: Public website information; no on-site audit. Food-assistance procedures do not establish physical access. The regular page permits choice shopping until closing; the holiday notice gives a 30-minute-earlier cutoff. Confirm the applicable date and any household-document alternatives or assistance needs before travelling. facts: Bea Taylor Market is a choice pantry where families in need can choose food to suit their household. The page does not specify residency boundaries, visit-frequency limits or appointment requirements; confirm individual arrangements.

Bea Taylor Market by Freestore Foodbank offers a choice pantry, much like a regular grocery store, to those in need. This means that families struggling to find vital nutrition can select the items that fit the needs of their family
The market asks visitors to bring picture ID and household verification, listing an address, birth certificate or medical card. Ask about alternatives if you cannot provide those documents.
WHAT TO BRING Picture ID Household Verification (Address, Birth Certificate, or Medical Card)
Regular opening hours are Tuesday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m., and Saturday, 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; Sunday and Monday are closed. Holiday arrangements may differ.
HOURS OF OPERATION Monday - CLOSED Tuesday - 9:00 am - 5:00 pm Wednesday - 9:00 am - 5:00 pm Thursday - 9:00 am - 5:00 pm Friday - 9:00 am - 5:00 pm Saturday - 10:00 am - 3:00 pm Sunday - CLOSED
The regular market page permits choice shopping until the posted closing time and asks late visitors to return the next business day. Confirm the applicable schedule before travelling.
Choice shopping is available until posted closing time. If you miss the time, please return the next business day.

Customers unable to shop during operating hours may receive a pre-packaged emergency meal box. The page reserves protein items for customers using choice shopping; it does not promise a particular box or dietary accommodation.
Customers unable to shop during operating hours may receive a pre-packaged emergency meal box. Protein items are exclusive to customers utilizing the choice shopping experience.
For market enquiries, the location page lists 513-357-4600 and 3401 Rosenthal Way. Confirm entrance, waiting and carrying-help arrangements before travelling.
CONTACT Bea Taylor Market 3401 Rosenthal Way Cincinnati, Ohio 45204 513-357-4600
